prevent_download_dinos.en: Blocks dino downloads from tribute storage.
prevent_download_dinos.zh-CN: 禁止从贡品上传存储下载生物。

prevent_download_items.en: Blocks item downloads from tribute storage.
prevent_download_items.zh-CN: 禁止从贡品上传存储下载物品。

prevent_download_survivors.en: Blocks survivor character downloads from the cluster.
prevent_download_survivors.zh-CN: 禁止下载已上传的幸存者角色。

prevent_mate_boost.en: Disables the mate-boost bonus that nearby breeding pairs normally grant one another.
prevent_mate_boost.zh-CN: 禁用附近异性同种生物之间的配偶增益。

prevent_offline_pvp.en: Protect structures and tames belonging to offline players from PvP damage.
prevent_offline_pvp.zh-CN: 为已离线玩家所属的建筑和生物启用离线 PvP 保护。

prevent_offline_pvp_interval.en: Delay in seconds after owners go offline before offline PvP protection begins.
prevent_offline_pvp_interval.zh-CN: 所有者离线后，开始应用离线 PvP 保护前等待的秒数。

prevent_spawn_animations.en: Skips spawn intro animation delays where supported.
prevent_spawn_animations.zh-CN: 跳过角色生成或重生时的入场动画。

prevent_upload_dinos.en: Blocks dino uploads into tribute storage.
prevent_upload_dinos.zh-CN: 禁止将生物上传到贡品存储。

prevent_upload_items.en: Blocks item uploads into tribute storage.
prevent_upload_items.zh-CN: 禁止将物品上传到贡品存储。

prevent_upload_survivors.en: Blocks survivor character uploads into tribute storage.
prevent_upload_survivors.zh-CN: 禁止将幸存者角色上传到贡品存储。

proximity_chat.en: Restrict text chat visibility to nearby players.
proximity_chat.zh-CN: 仅允许附近的玩家看到彼此的文字聊天消息。

pve_allow_structures_at_supply_drops.en: Allows building near supply drop locations while in PvE mode.
pve_allow_structures_at_supply_drops.zh-CN: 允许在 PvE 模式中靠近补给箱落点建造。

pve_dino_decay_period_multiplier.en: Scales how long abandoned PvE dinos keep their ownership before decaying.
pve_dino_decay_period_multiplier.zh-CN: PvE 生物所有权衰退时间倍率；数值越大，变为可认领前等待越久。

pve_structure_decay_period_multiplier.en: Scales how long PvE structures last before decay timers expire.
pve_structure_decay_period_multiplier.zh-CN: PvE 建筑衰退时间倍率；数值越大，建筑衰退越慢。

random_supply_crate_points.en: Place supply drops at randomized locations.
random_supply_crate_points.zh-CN: 在随机位置生成补给箱。

rcon_enabled.en: Enables remote RCON commands, including player-management commands. Written to GameUserSettings.ini [ServerSettings] as RCONEnabled.
rcon_enabled.zh-CN: 启用远程控制台；连接时使用配置的 RCON 端口和管理员密码。

resource_no_replenish_radius_players.en: Player-side no-respawn radius for nearby resources.
resource_no_replenish_radius_players.zh-CN: 玩家附近禁止资源再生的半径倍率；数值越大，禁刷新区域越大。

resource_no_replenish_radius_structures.en: Structure-side no-respawn radius for nearby resources.
resource_no_replenish_radius_structures.zh-CN: 建筑附近禁止资源再生的半径倍率；数值越大，禁刷新区域越大。

resources_respawn_period_multiplier.en: Scale the delay before harvested resources respawn; higher values mean a longer wait.
resources_respawn_period_multiplier.zh-CN: 资源再生等待时间倍率；数值越大，树木和矿石等资源再生越慢。

server_auto_force_respawn_wild_dinos_int.en: Automatically wipes and respawns wild creatures on a fixed timer.
server_auto_force_respawn_wild_dinos_int.zh-CN: 按指定秒数间隔清除并重新生成野生生物。

server_force_no_hud.en: Forces the in-game HUD off for every player.
server_force_no_hud.zh-CN: 对所有玩家强制隐藏游戏 HUD 界面。

server_game_log.en: Write gameplay events to the server game log.
server_game_log.zh-CN: 将游戏事件写入服务器游戏日志。

server_game_log_include_tribe_logs.en: Include tribe events in server game logs and RCON log output.
server_game_log_include_tribe_logs.zh-CN: 把部落日志事件也写入服务器游戏日志及 RCON 日志输出。

server_hardcore.en: Enable hardcore mode, where survivor death resets the character's level.
server_hardcore.zh-CN: 启用硬核模式；死亡会使幸存者角色等级重置。

server_name.en: Displayed in the in-game server browser and written to SessionName.
server_name.zh-CN: 在游戏服务器列表中显示的名称。

server_password.zh-CN: 玩家加入时使用的密码；留空允许无需密码加入。

server_pve.en: Runs the server with PvE rules when enabled.
server_pve.zh-CN: 启用 PvE 规则，限制玩家之间的敌对伤害。

show_creative_mode.en: Keeps the creative-mode toggle visible to eligible players and admins.
show_creative_mode.zh-CN: 在暂停菜单中显示创造模式选项。

show_floating_damage_text.en: Shows RPG-style floating damage numbers to players.
show_floating_damage_text.zh-CN: 以飘字形式显示攻击造成的伤害数值。

show_map_player_location.en: Show the player's current position on the in-game map.
show_map_player_location.zh-CN: 在游戏地图上显示玩家当前位置。

spectator_password.en: Optional password for non-admin spectator access.
spectator_password.zh-CN: 非管理员进入观战模式时使用的密码。

structure_damage_multiplier.en: Scales the damage dealt by player-built structures where the server exposes that value.
structure_damage_multiplier.zh-CN: 建筑造成的伤害倍率；数值越大，造成的伤害越高。

structure_pickup_hold_duration.en: Seconds to hold the quick-pickup action; 0 makes pickup immediate.
structure_pickup_hold_duration.zh-CN: 快速拾取建筑需要持续按住操作的秒数；0 表示立即拾取。

structure_pickup_time_after_placement.en: Seconds after placing a structure during which quick pickup remains available.
structure_pickup_time_after_placement.zh-CN: 建筑放置后允许快速拾取的时间窗口，单位为秒。

structure_resistance_multiplier.en: Scales how much incoming damage structures take from attacks.
structure_resistance_multiplier.zh-CN: 建筑承受伤害倍率；数值越大，受到的伤害越高。

supply_crate_loot_quality_multiplier.en: Controls the quality multiplier for supply crate loot.
supply_crate_loot_quality_multiplier.zh-CN: 补给箱战利品品质倍率；数值越大，战利品品质越高。

tamed_dino_damage_multiplier.en: Scales the damage dealt by tamed creatures.
tamed_dino_damage_multiplier.zh-CN: 驯养生物攻击伤害倍率；数值越大，造成的伤害越高。

tamed_dino_resistance_multiplier.en: Scales how much incoming damage tamed creatures take.
tamed_dino_resistance_multiplier.zh-CN: 驯养生物承受伤害倍率；数值越大，受到的伤害越高。

taming_speed_multiplier.zh-CN: 驯服速度倍率；数值越大，驯服越快。

the_max_structures_in_range.en: Maximum structures allowed within the hard-coded placement radius.
the_max_structures_in_range.zh-CN: 游戏固定检测半径内允许的建筑部件数量上限。

tribe_log_destroyed_enemy_structures.en: Shows destroyed enemy structures in the victim tribe log.
tribe_log_destroyed_enemy_structures.zh-CN: 将摧毁敌方建筑的事件记录到部落日志中。

tribute_character_expiration_seconds.en: How long uploaded survivor characters remain downloadable. Use 0 for no expiration.
tribute_character_expiration_seconds.zh-CN: 已上传幸存者在存储中保留的秒数。

tribute_dino_expiration_seconds.en: How long uploaded dinos remain downloadable from tribute.
tribute_dino_expiration_seconds.zh-CN: 已上传生物在存储中保留的秒数。

tribute_item_expiration_seconds.en: How long uploaded items remain downloadable from tribute.
tribute_item_expiration_seconds.zh-CN: 已上传物品在存储中保留的秒数。

use_dino_level_up_animations.en: Keeps the default level-up animation on tamed creatures instead of suppressing it.
use_dino_level_up_animations.zh-CN: 生物升级时播放升级动画。

use_dynamic_config.en: Load supported runtime-adjustable settings from the configured dynamic-configuration URL.
use_dynamic_config.zh-CN: 启用动态配置，从配置的网址加载可在运行时调整的服务器规则。

use_singleplayer_settings.en: Apply the game's single-player balancing preset, including taming and breeding adjustments.
use_singleplayer_settings.zh-CN: 应用游戏的单人平衡设置，改变驯服、繁育等多项倍率。

xp_multiplier.zh-CN: 全局经验获取倍率；数值越大，获得经验越多。
